environment.description: Same NestJS microservice deployed in namespace 'user-service-ns' on GKE cluster with Istio 1.19. Istio PeerAuthentication set to STRICT mTLS for the mesh. An AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied in the 'user-service-ns' namespace with a DENY action matching source principals from namespaces other than 'user-service-ns' itself for paths prefixed with '/users/' — however, a separate CUSTOM action AuthorizationPolicy delegates '/internal/*' path authorization to an ext-authz provider ('admin-authz-grpc.istio-system.svc.cluster.local') which validates that the source workload identity matches 'cluster.local/ns/admin-ns/sa/admin-service-account'. The ext-authz provider is registered in the mesh config extensionProviders array. Note: the DENY policy only covers '/users/' prefix paths and does NOT explicitly mention '/internal/' paths — the '/internal/' paths are gated solely by the CUSTOM ext-authz policy which requires the specific SPIFFE identity.
